''See also: [[Regent Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Regents]] are a group of exceptionally powerful individuals who serve as representatives for the Emperor. Historically, they were personal companions to the Emperor and were intended to be his successors. They are known to sleep for long periods, awakening only when humanity requires their defense against massive rebellions or the emergence of [[Great Elders]]. Because they act with the Emperor's [[Authority|authority]], their words carry his weight. They are considered peers to the Emperor in power and are among the most capable [[Readers]] in existence. Several specific [[Regents]] are identified: * [[Alagaeus]]: The [[Regent of the East]], who has not received petitioners in nearly five centuries.
* [[Jorin Curse-breaker|Jorin Maze-walker]]: The [[Regent of the South]], noted for his curiosity and unique manner of speaking.
* [[Loreli]]: Also known as the Strategist, she is the [[Regent of the West]] and the founder of the [[Luminian Order]]. A legendary figure who has lived since before [[The Empire|the Empire]], she is a multifaceted leader described as a tactician, healer, and religious icon. She is known for her ability to strike down [[Great Elders]] and her signature silver-and-white armor.
* [[Estyr]]: A Regent held in high regard as an equal to the Emperor. The [[Regents]] play a critical role in maintaining order, such as keeping [[Guild Heads]] in line and protecting the people under their watch. However, some view them as arrogant protectors who treat others like sheep.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Loreli]] has requested a report from [[Nathanael Bareius|Bareius]]. [[Loreli and Estyr]] both hold the title of Regent.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Loreli's Regency}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Loreli]] serves as a Regent.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c5">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 5</ref> During her tenure, she provided assistance to the [[Guild of Magisters|Magister's Guild]] in the creation of the crown's box.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref> Should she locate [[Calder]], he faces the possibility of being imprisoned in a [[Palace cell]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref>}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Regent|Regent Loreli]] assisted the Guild of Magisters{{!}}Magister's Guild in making the crown's box.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|If the [[Regent]] finds [[Calder]], he might end up in a [[Palace cell]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As some of the most powerful [[Readers]] to have ever existed, [[Regents]] hold significant influence.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c19">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 19</ref> During a meeting with [[Nathanael Bareius|Bareius]], the Regent requested a report.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> A hazy gray light constantly surrounds the Regent, who is [[Loreli]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> [[Loreli]] wears silver-and-white [[Luminian armor]] and serves as a Regent alongside [[Estyr]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" /> These [[Regents]] are responsible for managing the business of [[Optasia]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}
